survey: One object: a rounded, slab-shaped calculator floating over a yellow pi-pattern background. It is turned in the picture plane, leaning clockwise about 20°, and is seen almost face-on. Its face is turned only slightly away, so a narrow band of the body's thickness shows along the left and bottom edges, and the top-left corner is rounded and catches a highlight. Parts: a small red solar strip at the top right of the face. Below it, a pale grey display window in a raised bezel. Below that, a 4x4 keypad: twelve dark-blue keys in three columns and four cyan keys in the right column. Every key's rows rise to the right along the body's top edge, and every column runs down-right along the body's left edge. Key spacing grows slightly toward the bottom, which is the corner nearer the viewer, so the keys follow the face's slight turn. The keys' raised sides show on the same lower edges as the body's thickness, so the keys and the body share one camera. There is no ground plane, so contact does not apply.
